Discus Throw Match.—(1) Jones (B), 101ft. 9; (2) Moreton (T), 100ft. 3; (3) Sutton (B), 96ft. 5. 1 Mile Match.—(1) Bingham (T); 2, Lucas (B); (3) Cohen (B). 4 mins. 32 2/5th. 440 Yards Match.—(1) Jarlett (B); (2) Donaldson (T); (3) Trodd (T). 53.9.
Webb was second to Trodd, T.C.C., in 440 yds., whilst Ernie Duffett gained us a valuable point by finishing 4th, although he pulled a muscle in the first 100 yds.
